properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt KDF dependency of @truffle/truffle: js-scrypt@^0.2.0 declared and aliased ("scrypt" → "js-scrypt" in webpack.config.js:180) so browser bundles can run the scrypt KDF that wallet/keystore dependencies (Ethereum V3 keystore secret derivation) require. All 3 sites seen (package.json, webpack alias, yarn.lock).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA512 is the MAC at the heart of BIP32 HD-wallet key derivation in packages/hdwallet: master key from the mnemonic seed (line 37, keyed with the "Bitcoin seed" master secret) and child-key derivation (line 127, keyed with the chain code). PQ posture: HMAC-SHA512 retains ~256-bit security under Grover — not Shor-vulnerable, but it feeds derivation of secp256k1 keys which are.
